description: Defines classes and methods for decoding preloaded data entries, including bit-level reading, Huffman decoding, and trie-based search functionality within the 'net::extras' namespace.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder
classes.description: Abstract class for decoding entries from preloaded data, including trie-based search and Huffman decoding.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader
classes.description: Provides bit-by-bit reading capabilities from a byte array, including size decoding and seeking.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Handles Huffman tree decoding and symbol decoding from a bitstream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder(const uint8_t* huffman_tree, size_t huffman_tree_size, const uint8_t* trie, size_t trie_bits, size_t trie_root_position)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Huffman and trie data for decoding.

methods.name: bool Decode(const std::string& search, bool* out_found)
methods.description: Decodes a search string against preloaded trie data to find matching entries.

methods.name: virtual bool ReadEntry(BitReader* reader, const std::string& search, size_t current_search_offset, bool* out_found) = 0
methods.description: Abstract method to read an entry from the data, to be implemented by subclasses.
